"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual block: BN-SiLU-dilated conv(k3)-BN-SiLU-conv1x1, added to the input."""
    def __init__(self, ch, dil):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 3, padding=dil, dilation=dil, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 1, bias=False)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.conv2.weight.mul_(0.3)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(F.silu(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(F.silu(self.bn2(h)))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    """Max-pool by 2, then a dense k3 conv to the next width (no activation: pre-act blocks follow)."""
    def __init__(self, cin, cout):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2)
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(cout)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.bn(self.conv(self.pool(x)))


class Up(nn.Module):
    """Nearest upsampling to the skip's length, 1x1 projection to the skip's width, added to the skip."""
    def __init__(self, cin, cout):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(cout)

    def forward(self, x, skip):
        x = F.interpolate(x, size=skip.shape[-1], mode="nearest")
        return skip + self.bn(self.conv(x))


class UNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, chs=(96, 128, 160, 176), stem_ks=15, head_hidden=96, n_targets=3, logvar_init=-4.5):
        super().__init__()
        c0, c1, c2, c3 = chs
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c0, stem_ks, padding=stem_ks // 2, bias=False),
                                  nn.BatchNorm1d(c0), nn.SiLU())
        self.enc0 = ResBlock(c0, 1)                                    # L240
        self.down1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 1), ResBlock(c1, 2))    # L120
        self.down2 = Down(c1, c2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c2, 1), ResBlock(c2, 2))    # L60
        self.down3 = Down(c2, c3)
        self.bott = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c3, 1), ResBlock(c3, 2))    # L30, covers the whole insert
        self.up1 = Up(c3, c2)
        self.dec1 = ResBlock(c2, 1)                                    # L60
        self.up2 = Up(c2, c1)
        self.dec2 = ResBlock(c1, 1)                                    # L120
        self.out_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c1)
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c1, 1, 1)
        feat = 2 * c1
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
                                       nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
                                         nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.logvar_head[-1].bias.fill_(logvar_init)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.enc0(self.stem(x))
        s1 = self.enc1(self.down1(x))
        s2 = self.enc2(self.down2(s1))
        x = self.bott(self.down3(s2))
        x = self.dec1(self.up1(x, s2))
        x = self.dec2(self.up2(x, s1))
        h = F.silu(self.out_bn(x))
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=-1).to(h.dtype)
        pooled = torch.cat([(h * w).sum(-1), h.mean(-1)], dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(pooled), self.logvar_head(pooled)], dim=1)

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual block: BN-SiLU-dilated conv(k3)-BN-SiLU-conv1x1, added to the input (from L3/C25)."""
    def __init__(self, ch, dil):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 3, padding=dil, dilation=dil, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 1, bias=False)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.conv2.weight.mul_(0.3)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(F.silu(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(F.silu(self.bn2(h)))
        return x + h


class BiLSTMBlock(nn.Module):
    """Residual pre-LayerNorm bidirectional LSTM over the length axis. The recurrence runs in float32
    outside autocast (cuDNN LSTM in bf16 is not reliable); the projection back to ch runs under autocast."""
    def __init__(self, ch, hidden, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(ch)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(ch, hidden, num_layers=1, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(2 * hidden, ch)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.proj.weight.mul_(0.3)
            self.proj.bias.zero_()

    def forward(self, x):
        h = x.transpose(1, 2)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            z = self.ln(h.float())
            z, _ = self.lstm(z.contiguous())
        z = self.proj(self.drop(z))
        return x + z.transpose(1, 2).to(x.dtype)


class CNNBiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch=160, stem_ks=15, dils1=(1, 2, 4, 8), dils2=(1, 2), hidden=128,
                 head_hidden=128, n_targets=3, logvar_init=-4.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, ch, stem_ks, padding=stem_ks // 2, bias=False),
                                  nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.SiLU())
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool1d(2)
        self.stage1 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(ch, d) for d in dils1])
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool1d(2)
        self.rnn = BiLSTMBlock(ch, hidden)
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(ch, d) for d in dils2])
        self.out_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.att = nn.Conv1d(ch, 1, 1)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * ch, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * ch, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.logvar_head[-1].bias.fill_(logvar_init)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stage1(self.pool1(x))
        x = self.pool2(x)
        x = self.rnn(x)
        x = self.stage2(x)
        x = F.silu(self.out_bn(x))
        w = torch.softmax(self.att(x).float(), dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
        p = torch.cat([x.mean(dim=2), (x * w).sum(dim=2)], dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(p), self.logvar_head(p)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return CNNBiLSTM()
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.gelu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.gelu(x + h)


def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.GELU())


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.proj(a)
        x = x + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c1=96, c2=160, d=256, n_layers=3, heads=8, max_len=128, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c1, 15), ResConv(c1, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c1, c2, 9), ResConv(c2, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c2, d, 5))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)
        h = h + self.pos[:, :h.shape[1]]
        for b in self.blocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ConvTransformer(n_targets=3)

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
import math


class S4DKernel(nn.Module):
    """Bidirectional diagonal S4 (S4D-Lin) kernel; returns a (H, L, L) Toeplitz mixing matrix."""
    def __init__(self, h, n=32, dt_min=1e-3, dt_max=1e-1):
        super().__init__()
        n2 = n // 2
        log_dt = torch.rand(h) * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min)) + math.log(dt_min)
        self.log_dt = nn.Parameter(log_dt)
        self.log_A_real = nn.Parameter(torch.log(0.5 * torch.ones(2, h, n2)))
        self.A_imag = nn.Parameter(math.pi * torch.arange(n2).float()[None, None, :].repeat(2, h, 1))
        self.C = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(2, h, n2, 2) * (0.5 ** 0.5))

    def kernel(self, L):
        with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", enabled=False):
            dt = torch.exp(self.log_dt.float())
            A = torch.complex(-torch.exp(self.log_A_real.float()), self.A_imag.float())
            dtA = A * dt[None, :, None]
            C = torch.view_as_complex(self.C.float().contiguous()) * (torch.exp(dtA) - 1.0) / A
            l = torch.arange(L, device=dt.device, dtype=torch.float32)
            V = torch.exp(dtA[..., None] * l)
            K = 2.0 * torch.einsum("dhn,dhnl->dhl", C, V).real
        return K  # (2, H, L): forward and backward kernels

    def toeplitz(self, L):
        K = self.kernel(L)
        kf, kb = K[0], K[1]
        full = torch.cat([kb[:, 1:].flip(-1), kf], dim=-1)  # (H, 2L-1), index lag + L - 1
        ar = torch.arange(L, device=K.device)
        idx = ar[:, None] - ar[None, :] + (L - 1)
        return full[:, idx]  # (H, L, L): T[h, i, j] = k(i - j)


class S4Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, h, n=32, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(h)
        self.kernel = S4DKernel(h, n)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(h))
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.out = nn.Conv1d(h, 2 * h, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        z = self.norm(x)
        L = z.shape[-1]
        T = self.kernel.toeplitz(L).to(z.dtype)
        y = torch.bmm(z.transpose(0, 1), T.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(0, 1)  # (B, H, L)
        y = y + z * self.D.to(z.dtype)[None, :, None]
        y = self.drop(self.act(y))
        y = F.glu(self.out(y), dim=1)
        return x + self.drop(y)


class ConvS4D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, h=256, n_blocks=3, n_state=32, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, 128, 15, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 192, 9, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(192), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(192, h, 5, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(h), nn.SiLU())
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[S4Block(h, n_state) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.final_norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(h)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(h, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(h, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.blocks(self.stem(x))
        hpool = self.final_norm(x).mean(dim=2)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(hpool), self.logvar_head(hpool)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ConvS4D(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LN transformer block on (N, L, d); residual projections zero-initialised so it starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)
        for m in (self.qkv, self.ff1):
            nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        for m in (self.proj, self.ff2):
            nn.init.zeros_(m.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.proj(a)
        x = x + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class LegNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(80, 96, 112, 128), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 head_hidden=128, activation=nn.SiLU, n_attn=2, heads=8, max_len=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        d = ch * 2
        # sequence-wide context on the pooled map (L = 15 at the 240-bp input)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.attn = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads) for _ in range(n_attn)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), activation(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), activation(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        h = x.transpose(1, 2)
        h = h + self.pos[:, :h.shape[1]]
        for b in self.attn:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return LegNet(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
import math


class S4DKernel(nn.Module):
    """Bidirectional diagonal S4 (S4D-Lin) kernel; returns a (H, L, L) Toeplitz mixing matrix."""
    def __init__(self, h, n=32, dt_min=1e-3, dt_max=1e-1):
        super().__init__()
        n2 = n // 2
        log_dt = torch.rand(h) * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min)) + math.log(dt_min)
        self.log_dt = nn.Parameter(log_dt)
        self.log_A_real = nn.Parameter(torch.log(0.5 * torch.ones(2, h, n2)))
        self.A_imag = nn.Parameter(math.pi * torch.arange(n2).float()[None, None, :].repeat(2, h, 1))
        self.C = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(2, h, n2, 2) * (0.5 ** 0.5))

    def kernel(self, L):
        with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", enabled=False):
            dt = torch.exp(self.log_dt.float())
            A = torch.complex(-torch.exp(self.log_A_real.float()), self.A_imag.float())
            dtA = A * dt[None, :, None]
            C = torch.view_as_complex(self.C.float().contiguous()) * (torch.exp(dtA) - 1.0) / A
            l = torch.arange(L, device=dt.device, dtype=torch.float32)
            V = torch.exp(dtA[..., None] * l)
            K = 2.0 * torch.einsum("dhn,dhnl->dhl", C, V).real
        return K  # (2, H, L): forward and backward kernels

    def toeplitz(self, L):
        K = self.kernel(L)
        kf, kb = K[0], K[1]
        full = torch.cat([kb[:, 1:].flip(-1), kf], dim=-1)  # (H, 2L-1), index lag + L - 1
        ar = torch.arange(L, device=K.device)
        idx = ar[:, None] - ar[None, :] + (L - 1)
        return full[:, idx]  # (H, L, L): T[h, i, j] = k(i - j)


class S4Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, h, n=32, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(h)
        self.kernel = S4DKernel(h, n)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(h))
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.out = nn.Conv1d(h, 2 * h, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        z = self.norm(x)
        L = z.shape[-1]
        T = self.kernel.toeplitz(L).to(z.dtype)
        y = torch.bmm(z.transpose(0, 1), T.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(0, 1)  # (B, H, L)
        y = y + z * self.D.to(z.dtype)[None, :, None]
        y = self.drop(self.act(y))
        y = F.glu(self.out(y), dim=1)
        return x + self.drop(y)


class ConvS4D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, h=384, n_blocks=4, n_state=32, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, 128, 15, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 192, 9, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(192), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(192, h, 5, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(h), nn.SiLU())
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[S4Block(h, n_state) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.final_norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(h)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(h, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(h, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.blocks(self.stem(x))
        hpool = self.final_norm(x).mean(dim=2)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(hpool), self.logvar_head(hpool)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ConvS4D(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks, act=True):
    layers = [nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout)]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.SiLU())
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ks=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.b2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.silu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.silu(x + h)


class Fuse(nn.Module):
    """HRNet exchange: every branch receives every other branch, resampled to its resolution (factor 2 per level)."""
    def __init__(self, chans):
        super().__init__()
        self.n = len(chans)
        self.maps = nn.ModuleDict()
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.n):
                if i != j:
                    self.maps[f"{j}_{i}"] = conv_bn(chans[j], chans[i], 1, act=False)

    def forward(self, xs):
        out = []
        for i in range(self.n):
            acc = xs[i]
            L = xs[i].shape[-1]
            for j in range(self.n):
                if j == i:
                    continue
                m = self.maps[f"{j}_{i}"]
                if j > i:
                    acc = acc + F.interpolate(m(xs[j]), size=L, mode="nearest")
                else:
                    f = 2 ** (i - j)
                    acc = acc + m(F.max_pool1d(xs[j], f))
            out.append(F.silu(acc))
        return out


class HRNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, chans=(64, 128, 192), n_modules=3, ks=9, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        c0, c1, c2 = chans
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, 64, 11), conv_bn(64, c0, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.to_mid = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c0, c1, 3))
        self.to_low = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c1, c2, 3))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.ModuleList([ResBlock(c, ks) for c in chans]) for _ in range(n_modules)])
        self.fuses = nn.ModuleList([Fuse(list(chans)) for _ in range(n_modules)])
        d = sum(chans)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        hi = self.stem(x)
        mid = self.to_mid(hi)
        lo = self.to_low(mid)
        xs = [hi, mid, lo]
        for blks, fuse in zip(self.blocks, self.fuses):
            xs = [b(t) for b, t in zip(blks, xs)]
            xs = fuse(xs)
        h = torch.cat([t.mean(dim=2) for t in xs], dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return HRNet1D(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks, dil):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=dil * (ks // 2), dilation=dil, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.silu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.silu(x + h)


class CNNBiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c1=128, c2=192, hid=128, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, c1, 15, padding=7, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.stage1 = nn.Sequential(
            ResBlock(c1, 5, 2),
            nn.Conv1d(c1, c2, 5, padding=2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(c2), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c2, 3, 2), ResBlock(c2, 3, 4))
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(c2, hid, num_layers=1, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        self.lstm_proj = nn.Linear(2 * hid, c2)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(c2)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(c2, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(c2, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lstm_proj.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lstm_proj.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stage2(self.stage1(self.stem(x)))  # (N, C, L/4)
        s = h.transpose(1, 2)
        r, _ = self.lstm(s)
        s = s + self.lstm_proj(r)
        p = self.norm(s).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(p), self.logvar_head(p)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return CNNBiLSTM(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.gelu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.gelu(x + h)


def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.GELU())


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=4, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.drop1(self.proj(a))
        x = x + self.drop2(self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x)))))
        return x


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c1=96, c2=160, d=256, n_layers=4, heads=8, max_len=128, head_hidden=256, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c1, 15), ResConv(c1, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c1, c2, 9), ResConv(c2, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c2, d, 5))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads, drop=drop) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)
        h = h + self.pos[:, :h.shape[1]]
        for b in self.blocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ConvTransformer(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks, act=True):
    layers = [nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout)]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.SiLU())
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ks=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.b2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.silu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.silu(x + h)


class Fuse(nn.Module):
    """HRNet exchange: every branch receives every other branch, resampled to its resolution (factor 2 per level)."""
    def __init__(self, chans):
        super().__init__()
        self.n = len(chans)
        self.maps = nn.ModuleDict()
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.n):
                if i != j:
                    self.maps[f"{j}_{i}"] = conv_bn(chans[j], chans[i], 1, act=False)

    def forward(self, xs):
        out = []
        for i in range(self.n):
            acc = xs[i]
            L = xs[i].shape[-1]
            for j in range(self.n):
                if j == i:
                    continue
                m = self.maps[f"{j}_{i}"]
                if j > i:
                    acc = acc + F.interpolate(m(xs[j]), size=L, mode="nearest")
                else:
                    f = 2 ** (i - j)
                    acc = acc + m(F.max_pool1d(xs[j], f))
            out.append(F.silu(acc))
        return out


class HRNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, chans=(64, 128, 192), n_modules=4, ks=9, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        c0, c1, c2 = chans
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, 64, 11), conv_bn(64, c0, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.to_mid = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c0, c1, 3))
        self.to_low = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c1, c2, 3))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.ModuleList([ResBlock(c, ks) for c in chans]) for _ in range(n_modules)])
        self.fuses = nn.ModuleList([Fuse(list(chans)) for _ in range(n_modules)])
        d = sum(chans)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        hi = self.stem(x)
        mid = self.to_mid(hi)
        lo = self.to_low(mid)
        xs = [hi, mid, lo]
        for blks, fuse in zip(self.blocks, self.fuses):
            xs = [b(t) for b, t in zip(blks, xs)]
            xs = fuse(xs)
        h = torch.cat([t.mean(dim=2) for t in xs], dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return HRNet1D(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.SiLU())


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    """Dense two-conv residual block; the last BatchNorm is zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, c, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.b2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.silu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.silu(x + h)


class DenseResNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, chans=(128, 192, 256), kss=(9, 7, 5), n_blocks=2, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        c0, c1, c2 = chans
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c0, 15), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.stage0 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c0, kss[0]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.down1 = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c0, c1, 3))
        self.stage1 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c1, kss[1]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.down2 = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c1, c2, 3))
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c2, kss[2]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c2, 2 * c2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(2 * c2), nn.SiLU())
        d = 2 * c2
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stage0(self.stem(x))
        h = self.stage1(self.down1(h))
        h = self.stage2(self.down2(h))
        h = self.mapper(h).mean(dim=2)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return DenseResNet(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.gelu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.gelu(x + h)


def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.GELU())


class MixerBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LN MLP-Mixer block on (N, L, d): a token-mixing MLP across the L positions (position-specific,
    dense), then a channel FFN. Residual output layers are zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, d, L, tok_hidden=128, ff=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.tok1 = nn.Linear(L, tok_hidden)
        self.tok2 = nn.Linear(tok_hidden, L)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.ln1(x).transpose(1, 2)            # (N, d, L)
        h = self.tok2(F.gelu(self.tok1(h))).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + h
        x = x + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class ConvMixer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c1=96, c2=160, d=256, n_layers=4, L=60, tok_hidden=128, ff=4, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.L = L
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c1, 15), ResConv(c1, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c1, c2, 9), ResConv(c2, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c2, d, 5))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([MixerBlock(d, L, tok_hidden, ff) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        for b in self.blocks:
            nn.init.zeros_(b.tok2.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(b.ff2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x)                             # (N, d, L) with L = 60 for the 240-bp input
        if h.shape[-1] != self.L:
            h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(h, self.L)
        h = h.transpose(1, 2)
        for b in self.blocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ConvMixer(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

This edit answers S22. The attention parameters get their own AdamW group at 0.2x lr (0.001) and QK-LayerNorm bounds the attention logits. """The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LN transformer block on (N, L, d) with QK-LayerNorm; residual projections zero-initialised so it
    starts as the identity."""
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.dh = d // heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.q_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.dh)
        self.k_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.dh)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)
        for m in (self.qkv, self.ff1):
            nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        for m in (self.proj, self.ff2):
            nn.init.zeros_(m.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, self.dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q = self.q_norm(q)
        k = self.k_norm(k)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.proj(a)
        x = x + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class LegNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(80, 96, 112, 128), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 head_hidden=128, activation=nn.SiLU, n_attn=2, heads=8, max_len=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        d = ch * 2
        # sequence-wide context on the pooled map (L = 15 at the 240-bp input); names 'attn_pos' and 'attn'
        # mark the parameters the optimizer trains at a lower lr
        self.attn_pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.attn = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads) for _ in range(n_attn)])
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), activation(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), activation(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))  # (N, d, L)
        L = x.shape[2]
        t = x.transpose(1, 2)
        z = t + self.attn_pos[:, :L]
        for blk in self.attn:
            z = blk(z)
        # positional embedding only steers attention; the residual stream keeps C1's features at init

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.SiLU())


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    """Dense two-conv residual block (from C15); the last BatchNorm is zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, c, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.b2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.silu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.silu(x + h)


class MixerBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LN MLP-Mixer block on (N, L, d): a token-mixing MLP across the L positions (position-specific,
    dense), then a channel FFN. Residual output layers are zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, d, L, tok_hidden=128, ff=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.tok1 = nn.Linear(L, tok_hidden)
        self.tok2 = nn.Linear(tok_hidden, L)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.ln1(x).transpose(1, 2)            # (N, d, L)
        h = self.tok2(F.gelu(self.tok1(h))).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + h
        x = x + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class ResMixer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c0=128, c1=192, d=256, kss=(9, 7), n_res=2, n_layers=4, L=60,
                 tok_hidden=128, ff=4, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.L = L
        # C15's dense ResNet stages 0-1, pooled to L60, then a 1x1 projection to the mixer width
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            conv_bn(4, c0, 15), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            *[ResBlock(c0, kss[0]) for _ in range(n_res)],
            nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c0, c1, 3),
            *[ResBlock(c1, kss[1]) for _ in range(n_res)],
            conv_bn(c1, d, 1))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([MixerBlock(d, L, tok_hidden, ff) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        for b in self.blocks:
            nn.init.zeros_(b.tok2.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(b.ff2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x)                             # (N, d, L) with L = 60 for the 240-bp input
        if h.shape[-1] != self.L:
            h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(h, self.L)
        h = h.transpose(1, 2)
        for b in self.blocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ResMixer(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six

for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.gelu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.gelu(x + h)


def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.GELU())


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.proj(a)
        x = x + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c1=96, c2=160, d=256, n_layers=4, heads=8, max_len=128, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c1, 15), ResConv(c1, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c1, c2, 9), ResConv(c2, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c2, d, 5))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)
        h = h + self.pos[:, :h.shape[1]]
        for b in self.blocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)

    """Dense two-conv residual block; the last BatchNorm is zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, c, ks):
        super().__init__()

        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)

    """Pre-LN transformer block on (N, L, d) with LayerNorm on queries and keys (QK-norm) for stability;
    the residual output projections are zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.dh = d // heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.qn = nn.LayerNorm(self.dh)
        self.kn = nn.LayerNorm(self.dh)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)
        for m in (self.qkv, self.ff1):
            nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        for m in (self.proj, self.ff2):
            nn.init.zeros_(m.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, self.dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q = self.qn(q)
        k = self.kn(k)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)

        h = self.stage1(self.down1(h))
        h = self.stage2(self.down2(h))
        L = h.shape[-1]
        t = h.transpose(1, 2)
        if L <= self.pos.shape[1]:
            pos = self.pos[:, :L]
        else:
            pos = F.interpolate(self.pos.transpose(1, 2), size=L, mode="linear", align_corners=False).transpose(1, 2)
        t = self.attn(t + pos.to(t.dtype))
        h = t.transpose(1, 2)
        h = self.mapper(h).mean(dim=2)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return DenseResNet(n_targets=3)

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class LegFrontBiLSTM(nn.Module):
    """LegNet's stem and first two stages (pool to L/4), then a residual bidirectional LSTM at L/4."""
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9, ef_block_sizes=(80, 96),
                 resize_factor=4, d=192, hid=128, head_hidden=256, activation=nn.SiLU):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = LocalBlock(4, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for out_ch in ef_block_sizes:
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(2)))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.to_d = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, d, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(d), activation())
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(d, hid, num_layers=1, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        self.lstm_proj = nn.Linear(2 * hid, d)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lstm_proj.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lstm_proj.bias)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), activation(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), activation(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.to_d(self.main(self.stem(x)))  # (N, d, L/4)
        s = h.transpose(1, 2)
        r, _ = self.lstm(s)
        s = s + self.lstm_proj(r)
        p = self.norm(s).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(p), self.logvar_head(p)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return LegFrontBiLSTM(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class ResConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.gelu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.gelu(x + h)


def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout), nn.GELU())


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=4, drop=0.1, dw_ks=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        # Conformer-style local token mixing inside the FFN branch
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, dw_ks, padding=dw_ks // 2, groups=d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.drop1(self.proj(a))
        h = self.dw(self.ln2(x).transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.drop2(self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(h))))
        return x


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, c1=96, c2=160, d=256, n_layers=4, heads=8, max_len=128, head_hidden=256, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c1, 15), ResConv(c1, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c1, c2, 9), ResConv(c2, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  conv_bn(c2, d, 5))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads, drop=drop) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)
        h = h + self.pos[:, :h.shape[1]]
        for b in self.blocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return ConvTransformer(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def conv_bn(cin, cout, ks):

class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    """Dense two-conv residual block; the last BatchNorm is zero-initialised so the block starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, c, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, ks, padding=ks // 2, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.b2.weight)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.silu(self.b1(self.c1(x)))
        h = self.b2(self.c2(h))
        return F.silu(x + h)


class DenseResNet(nn.Module):
    """Shared stem, stage0 and stage1; then the trunk forks: the mean branch and the log-variance branch each
    have their own down-sampling, stage2 and mapper (one network, one set of weights, different outputs)."""
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, chans=(128, 192, 256), kss=(9, 7, 5), n_blocks=3, head_hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        c0, c1, c2 = chans
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(conv_bn(4, c0, 15), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.stage0 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c0, kss[0]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.down1 = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c0, c1, 3))
        self.stage1 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c1, kss[1]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        # mean branch (as in C22)
        self.down2 = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c1, c2, 3))
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c2, kss[2]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c2, 2 * c2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(2 * c2), nn.SiLU())
        # log-variance branch: its own deep stage
        self.down2_v = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(2), conv_bn(c1, c2, 3))
        self.stage2_v = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c2, kss[2]) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.mapper_v = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c2, 2 * c2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(2 * c2), nn.SiLU())
        d = 2 * c2
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stage0(self.stem(x))
        h = self.stage1(self.down1(h))
        hm = self.mapper(self.stage2(self.down2(h))).mean(dim=2)
        hv = self.mapper_v(self.stage2_v(self.down2_v(h))).mean(dim=2)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(hm), self.logvar_head(hv)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""

"""The student: MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), the baseline of the Gosai search, with six
outputs: the mean of the teacher ensemble's prediction for K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, then its log variance
for each (log2 fold change). Same network as the Gosai search's baseline; only the last layer is wider.

Input (N, 4, W) one-hot A, C, G, T as built by train.student_input (the baseline's window is the 200-bp
insert with 20 bp of plasmid flank each side, W = 240). Output (N, 6).
"""
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class TBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads=8, ff=4, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff * d, d)
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, L, d = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(n, L, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(n, L, d)
        x = x + self.drop1(self.proj(a))
        x = x + self.drop2(self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x)))))
        return x


class EffTransformer(nn.Module):
    """LegNet's stem and first three EffBlock stages (pooled to L30), then pre-LN transformer blocks."""
    def __init__(self, n_targets=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(80, 96, 112), resize_factor=4, d=256, n_layers=3, heads=8,
                 max_len=64, head_hidden=256, drop=0.1, activation=nn.SiLU):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for out_ch in ef_block_sizes:
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(2)))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, d, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(d), activation())
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, max_len, d) * 0.02)
        self.tblocks = nn.ModuleList([TBlock(d, heads, drop=drop) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        # separate branches for the means and the log variances (one trunk, one set of weights)
        self.mean_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        self.logvar_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, head_hidden), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(head_hidden, n_targets))
        for mod in (self.tblocks, self.mean_head, self.logvar_head):
            for m in mod.modules():
                if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.trunc_normal_(m.weight, std=0.02)
                    if m.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x))).transpose(1, 2)
        h = h + self.pos[:, :h.shape[1]]
        for b in self.tblocks:
            h = b(h)
        h = self.ln(h).mean(dim=1)
        return torch.cat([self.mean_head(h), self.logvar_head(h)], dim=1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the student: one-hot (N, 4, W) from train.student_input -> (N, 6) = [3 means, 3 log variances]."""
    return EffTransformer(n_targets=3)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

        b = c // 3
        self.br3 = nn.Conv1d(c, b, 3, padding=1, bias=False)

        nn.init.zeros_(self.bn2.weight)

        h = torch.cat([self.br3(x), self.br9(x), self.brd(x)], dim=1)

class IncBlock(nn.Module):
    """Inception-style residual block: three parallel dense branches of different reach (k3, k9, k5 dilated 4),
    concatenated to c channels, BN-SiLU, then a 1x1 projection whose BatchNorm is zero-initialised (identity start)."""
